Khasta thekuaa, ise khajuriya (Khajuria recipe) ya khajur (Khajur recipe) bhi kahte hai. bina sanche ke gur vala thekuaa kaise banaen ? ye chhath puja speshal khasta Thekua without mould vali aasan resipi hai.
How to make thekua perfectly crispy – do se lekar phraee karne tak har tip ke sath.
Ingredients for Atta Gur Thekua Recipe
Chini - Sugar - ½ cup (100g)
Suji - Semolina - ¼ cup (50g)
Gehun ka aata - Wheat Flour - 2 cup (300g)
Saunph - Fennel - 1 tsp
Ilaichi - Cardamom - ½ tsp (crushed)
